schema.description: One body weight, from a records file. Two records sources write it: the Fitbit weight log export, extracted by scripts/extract-fitbit-weight.py, and weights noted in the blood pressure diary, read into records by hand. Values are the source's own figures.

bmi.description: Body mass index as Fitbit computed it, the export's fourth column. Fitbit rows only, and only when the log has one.

date.description: When the weight was logged, local Sydney time to the minute. For Fitbit rows the extractor rewrites logged_as in this form; diary rows give the date and time read from the diary. This is the fact time.

id.description: The records row's id. Fitbit rows are fitbit: and the log's minute, with :2 and up added when two logs share a minute; diary rows carry the diary's own prefix and the day.

kg.description: Body weight in kilograms as the source wrote it. The Fitbit extractor refuses a log whose unit column is not kilograms.

logged_as.description: The Fitbit export's log time, first column, verbatim. Fitbit rows only.

source_note.description: Where the row came from, in words. The Fitbit extractor writes a fixed note; diary rows carry the reader's note.
